AbstractText.Label: PURPOSE OF REVIEW
AbstractText.content: Next-generation sequencing, especially whole exome sequencing (WES), has revolutionized the molecular diagnosis of inborn errors of immunity. This review summarizes the generation and analysis of next-generation sequencing data.

AbstractText.Label: RECENT FINDINGS
AbstractText.content: The focus is on prioritizing strategies for unveiling the potential disease-causing variant. We also highlighted oversights and imperfections of WES and targeted panel sequencing, as well as the need for functional validation.

AbstractText.Label: SUMMARY
AbstractText.content: The information is crucial for a judicious use of WES by researchers, but even more so by the clinical immunologist.
